construct: BM25 over the three fields a picker line exposes (name, slug, whenToUse). A retrieval proxy, not a model result: it says nothing about commit-versus-ask, position or provider variance.

provenance.gate: Authored for this gate by the reviewer (2026-11-20), phrased as a user would write and deliberately NOT copied from the catalogue's whenToUse lines. They carry the E2 recognition risk: a high rate shows the author recognises their own names. The claim they support is regression (does an edit move an answer), not validity.
provenance.report: Taken verbatim from the briefs screened in docs/research/modes-experiment-log.md §28 and §29. They are ambiguous by construction and must never fail the gate.
